svg.aria-label: Four tiles. Oblique: the lower circle stays level while the upper square rises. Contrary: the lower circle falls while the upper square rises. Similar: both rise, the lower by more than the upper. Strict parallel: both rise by the same amount, shown with two equal dotted brackets. No pitch names are shown.
svg.title: Four motion glyphs

g.text: SHARED · MOVEMENT WORDS
Four ways two voices can travel
Oblique
One voice holds; the other moves.
Contrary
The voices go opposite ways, apart or
together.
Similar
Both go the same way, by different
amounts.
Strict parallel
Same way, same number of semitones.
Circle = lower voice, square = upper voice.
Arrows only; the exact notes are on the
lesson pictures.
How to read this graphic: In each sketch the
filled circle is the lower voice and the
square is the upper voice, moving left to
right. Watch the arrows: level or rising,
opposite directions, same direction. The last
sketch has two equal brackets to show that
the distance travelled is the same.
